let J (p : ℝ × ℂ) := hole k.succ (u p.2) (morn (t p.2) k p.1)∈strict (n+2) ∧
    hole k.castSucc (u p.2) (eve (t p.2) k p.1)∈strict (n+2) ∧ u p.2 ∈ strict (n+1)
  obtain ⟨r,hr',M,hM⟩ := neighborhoods (F:= {p : ℝ × ℂ | J p}) (R:=fun p : ℝ × ℂ => ‖X p.1 p.2‖)
    (L:=𝓝[>] 0) he (by
      rintro z ⟨d,hh',rfl⟩
      let x := t d
      have hr (i : Fin (n+1)) : (x.1.2 i).im = (p.1.2 i).im := by simp [x,t,u]
      have hp : x.1.2 ∈ strict (n+1) := by intro i j ht; simp only [hr]; exact hu ht
      have hd : allows x g k := fun i r hr => lt_of_le_of_lt (by change |(0:ℝ)| ≤ |p.2|; simp [abs_nonneg]) (hs i r hr)
      have hv : atlases Z (sundial x k) k := by simp_rw [sundial,hr]; exact hh
      have hy : Tendsto (fun p : ℝ × ℂ => (t p.2,p.1)) (𝓝[>] 0 ×ˢ 𝓝 (d:ℂ)) ((𝓝 x) ×ˢ 𝓝[>] 0) :=
        ((ht.tendsto _).comp tendsto_snd).prodMk tendsto_fst
      obtain ⟨a,b,ha,hb⟩ := first_ports K T V k x hp hv w g hg hd
      refine ⟨?_,‖a-b‖+1,((ha.sub hb).comp hy).norm.eventually (ge_mem_nhds (by simp))⟩
      have hi := (show Continuous (fun i : Dock (n+1) => i.1.2) from by fun_prop).tendsto x
      filter_upwards [hy.eventually (affordable x hp k), (tendsto_fst.comp hy).eventually (hi.eventually ((open_strict (n+1)).mem_nhds hp))] with i hi hi'
      exact ⟨hi.1, hi.2, hi'⟩)

proof_context.conclusion: A neighbourhood `thickening r` of `[0,1]` keeps the strict height gaps for the after (`succ`) and before (`castSucc`) insertions, and the jump has a bound `M` uniform for small `s`.

lemma first_ports (K : Killing) (T : S.Stress) (v : Fin n → S.Union) (k : Fin n)
    (p : Dock n) (hp : p.1.2∈strict n) (he : atlases Z (sundial p k) k) (w : Prospect F Z U P H T)
    (g : Probe Space3) (hg : HasCompactSupport ⇑g) (hr : allows p g k) :
    ∃ a b : ℂ,
      Tendsto (crest Z K T v g k) (𝓝 p ×ˢ 𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 a) ∧
      Tendsto (trough Z K T v g k) (𝓝 p ×ˢ 𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 b) := by

proof_context.conclusion: `first_ports` gives limits of both side terms in the dock and the offset `s`, near the base point, under the spacelike-germ hypothesis `atlases`.

lemma tidal_shift (K : Killing) (T : S.Stress) (v : Fin n → S.Union) (k : Fin n)
    (p : Dock n) (hp : p.1.2∈strict n) (he : atlases Z (sundial p k) k) (hZ : Z.FullBody F)
    (g : Probe Space3) (hg : HasCompactSupport ⇑g) (hr : allows p g k) :
    ∃ a : ℂ,
      Tendsto (fun w : Dock n × ℝ => docks Z K v T g k.succ w.1.1.1 w.1.1.2 (morn w.1 k w.2))
        (𝓝 p ×ˢ 𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 a) ∧
      Tendsto (fun w : Dock n × ℝ => docks Z K v T g k.castSucc w.1.1.1 w.1.1.2 (eve w.1 k w.2))
        (𝓝 p ×ˢ 𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 a) := by

proof_context.conclusion: Under `atlases` and `allows`, the gradient-cutoff terms `docks` on both sides converge to a common limit.
